statement: A company must give notice to HMRC of the beginning of its first accounting period, and of the beginning of any accounting period that does not immediately follow the end of a previous one, not later than three months after the beginning of the accounting period.
caveat: When an accounting period begins turns on when the company comes within the charge to corporation tax, which is a facts-based question. Companies incorporated through Companies House are offered corporation tax setup at registration; follow HMRC's current registration guidance for dormant and later-activated companies.
